blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Low-light video processing remains an underexplored problem in computer vision, primarily due to the scarcity of high-quality ground-truth data. Existing public datasets exhibit several limitations, including restricted motion diversity, limited scene coverage, weak degradations, reliance on auxiliary modalities such as event data, and misalignment between low-light inputs and ground truth. Furthermore, current datasets typically address either low-light enhancement or scene understanding, whereas these tasks should be considered jointly. We introduce \textbf{OLiVES}, a benchmark dataset for outdoor low-light videos with dynamic scenes, designed to support both low-light video enhancement (LLVE) and video object segmentation (VOS). The dataset addresses key content gaps by incorporating a diverse range of natural textures, animals, occlusions, dynamic activities, and close-up scenes. To the best of our knowledge, OLiVES is the first outdoor low-light video dataset captured using professional cinema-grade cameras. It provides over 25,000 aligned normal- and low-light frame pairs, along with over 46,000 VOS annotations. We benchmark state-of-the-art LLVE and VOS methods on OLiVES and show that training on it improves performance on both tasks. The OLiVES project page is available at: https://anonymous-OLiVES.github.io/.
blocks.zh: 低光度视频处理仍然是计算机视觉中一个未得到充分探讨的问题,主要原因是缺乏高质量的地面真实数据。 现有的公共数据集呈现出若干局限性,包括运动多样性有限,场景覆盖面有限,退化程度低,依赖事件数据等辅助模式,低光输入和地面真相之间错配. 此外,目前的数据集通常涉及低光度增强或场景理解,而这些任务应共同考虑。 我们引入\textbf{OLiVES},是室外低光视频具有动态场景的基准数据集,旨在同时支持低光视频增强(LLVE)和视频对象分区(VOS). 该数据集通过纳入各种自然纹理、动物、隐蔽物、动态活动和特写场景来解决关键内容差距。 据我们所知,OLiVES是第一个使用专业影院级摄像头捕获的室外低光视频数据集. 它提供超过25,000对对齐的普通和低光框对,以及超过46,000对VOS说明. 我们把最新技术的LLVE和VOS方法作为OLiVES的基准,并表明这方面的培训可以提高这两项任务的业绩。 OLiVES项目网页见:https://anonymous-OLiVES.github.io/。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Enhancing the visibility and understanding of scenes captured under low-light conditions is highly desired due to its applicability to autonomous vehicles, surveillance, wildlife filmmaking and conservation, etc. While many computer vision methods show strong performance in well-lit scenes, their performance degrades significantly in low-light conditions [ 3 , 40 , 31 , 30 ] .
There are many reasons for this reduction in performance including noise, blur, low brightness/contrast and computational resources required to process videos.
blocks.zh:
由于适用于自主车辆,监视,野生生物取景和保存等,因此对在低光条件下捕捉到的场景的能见度和理解度非常理想. 虽然许多计算机视觉方法在光线良好的场景中表现出了强大的性能,但其性能在低光条件下会显著地下降[3,40,31,30].
这种性能下降的原因很多,包括噪音,模糊,亮度低/相干和处理视频所需的计算资源等.

blocks.en: Low-light video enhancement (LLVE) has emerged as a key task to address these challenges, aiming to improve perceptual quality or serve as a pre-processing step for downstream tasks. Low-light video enhancement provides an added challenge when compared to its image counterpart, low-light image enhancement (LLIE), due to the importance of temporal consistency. One major challenge in constructing LLVE dataset is the acquisition of paired low-light frames and corresponding ground-truth (GT). Most existing datasets adopt physical alignment methods to overcome this challenge, e.g. dual-camera systems [ 4 ] or repeated shooting of the same scene [ 31 ] . However, due to the constraints of the capture setup, the recorded videos are typically limited to either static scenes or scenes containing no moving objects. As a result, these datasets fail to adequately represent the complex motion patterns commonly encountered in real-world low-light environments. Furthermore, we observe that several existing datasets exhibit low degradation levels, e.g. DID [ 13 ] which simply reduces ISO to capture low-light videos.
blocks.zh: 低光能视频增强(LLVE)已成为应对这些挑战的一项关键任务,目的是提高知觉质量或作为下游任务的预处理步骤. 由于时间一致性的重要性,与图像对应的低光视频增强(LLIE)相比,低光视频增强提供了额外的挑战. 在构建LLVE数据集方面的一个主要挑战是获取成对的低光帧和相应的地真(GT). 大多数已存在的数据集都采用了物理对接方法来克服这一挑战,例如双相机系统[4]或同场重复射击[31]. 然而,由于捕获设置的限制,所录入的视频一般限于静态场景或没有移动物体的场景. 因此,这些数据集未能充分代表现实世界低光环境下常见的复杂运动模式. 此外,我们还注意到,一些现有数据集的降解水平较低,例如,DOD[13]只是减少ISO捕获低光能视频。

blocks.en:
Video object segmentation (VOS) is a further challenging downstream task whose objective is to segment and track target objects across frames. While numerous VOS benchmarks have been released [ 35 , 36 , 42 , 46 , 10 , 11 ] , the vast majority focus on well-lit conditions; to our knowledge, only Li et al. [23] has explored VOS in low-light through their LLE-VOS dataset. One of the main limitations of this dataset is that it is designed to leverage event data, which is not captured by most cameras, thus restricting its real-world applicability.
More broadly, downstream tasks in low-light conditions remain under-studied, in large part because of the scarcity of training data. A common workaround is to apply a low-light enhancement step before feeding frames into models trained on predominantly well-lit datasets. However, despite recent progress in enhancement techniques [ 16 , 2 , 21 , 26 ] , this two-stage pipeline often hinders downstream performance. Enhancement methods improve perceptual quality but degrade the semantic cues that downstream models rely on [ 5 , 23 , 29 , 30 ] . Moreover, existing studies indicate that jointly optimizing low-level enhancement and high-level semantics is beneficial to both tasks, improving restoration quality while simultaneously enhancing downstream performance [ 39 , 52 , 34 , 15 , 19 , 30 ] .
To the best of our knowledge, the only low-light video benchmark for both enhancement and a downstream task (semantic segmentation) is SDE [ 4 ] . Howevever, SDE has notable limitations: object motion is restricted (due to its setup) and the annotations are generated using off-the-shelf deep learning models without manual verification.
blocks.zh:
视频对象分解(VOS)是一项更具有挑战性的下游任务,其目标是分出并跟踪跨帧的目标对象. 虽然许多VOS基准已经发布[35,36,42,46,10,11],但绝大多数关注的是井口条件;据我们所知,只有李等. [23]通过其LLE-VOS数据集在低光下探索了VOS. 这个数据集的主要限制之一是它的设计是为了利用事件数据,而大多数相机没有捕捉到数据,从而限制了其真实世界的适用性.
更广泛地说,低光度条件下的下游任务仍然缺乏研究,这在很大程度上是由于培训数据的缺乏。 一个常见的变通办法是,在将框架输入主要使用高通量数据集的模型之前,先采用低光增强步骤。 然而,尽管最近在增强技术[16,2,21,26]方面取得了进展,但这一两阶段管道往往会阻碍下游的性能. 增强方法提高了知觉质量,但降低了下游模型所依赖的语义提示[5、23、29、30]。 此外,现有研究表明,联合优化低水平增强和高水平语义对这两项任务都有好处,提高了恢复质量,同时提高了下游的性能[39,52,34,15,19,30].
据我们所知,增强和下游任务(语义分解)的唯一低光视频基准是SDE [4]. Howevever, SDE有显著的局限性:对象运动受到限制(因其设置),并使用现成的深层学习模型生成说明而无需人工验证.

blocks.en:
To address these challenges, we propose a new low-light benchmark, O utdoor L ow-L i ght V ideos for E nhancement and S egmentation ( OLiVES ), supporting joint LLVE and VOS tasks on real-world low-light videos. Example videos are shown in Fig. 1 .
OLiVES provides 25,254 registered normal/low-light frames for low-light video enhancement and 46,366 pixel-wise segmentation annotations for the low-light VOS task. Unlike existing datasets that treat these tasks independently, our benchmark enables a unified evaluation of restoration and downstream understanding, encouraging research for improving both perceptual and semantic quality.
To capture diverse lighting conditions, including extreme low-light scenarios, we employ three Neutral Density (ND) filters of varying transmittance while keeping ISO and exposure time fixed. Crucially, OLiVES is captured with professional cinema-grade cameras, yielding high-fidelity footage under genuine outdoor lighting. The resulting scenes feature animals, natural textures, foliage, and dynamic outdoor activity. This opens up benchmarking and model development for application areas underserved by existing datasets, such as natural history filmmaking, wildlife monitoring, and nighttime surveillance.
blocks.zh:
为了应对这些挑战,我们提出一个新的低光度基准,O utdoor L ow-L i ght V ideos for E nhancement and S partment (OLiVES),支持LLVE和VOS在现实世界低光视频上的联合任务. 示例视频以图1显示。
OLiVES为低光视频增强提供了25,254个已注册的普通/低光相框,为低光VOS任务提供了46,366个像素视距分解说明. 与独立处理这些任务的现有数据集不同,我们的基准使得能够对恢复和下游理解进行统一评价,鼓励研究以提高知觉和语义的质量。
为了捕捉各种照明条件,包括极低光度的情景,我们采用了三个具有不同传动的中性密度(ND)滤波器,同时保持ISO和曝光时间的固定. 关键的是,OLiVES是用专业的电影级相机捕获的,在真正的室外照明下产生出高真实度的镜头. 由此产生的场景以动物,自然纹理,叶片,和动态户外活动为特色. 这为现有数据集所服务不足的应用领域,例如自然历史电影制作、野生生物监测和夜间监测,开启了基准和模型开发。

blocks.en:
DRV [ 3 ] (also known as SMID) is a RAW low-light video dataset with aligned short/long-exposure pairs from a single device with ground truth restricted to static scenes.
SDSD [ 40 ] is a public low-light video dataset captured with a mechatronic system, but suffers from spatial misalignment between normal/low-light pairs and inconsistent scenarios.
DID [ 13 ] is the largest LLVE dataset by frame count, using five cameras to capture diverse degradations. However, it synthesizes low-light by reducing ISO under well-lit conditions, limiting realism and noise modelling, and its gimbal setup restricts motion to linear trajectories.
LLRVD [ 14 ] is a low-light RAW dataset with richer motion, obtained by recording videos displayed on a Dell U2720QM monitor; however, the lighting is not physically realistic, and the dataset contains only 4,086 pairs.
BVI-RLV [ 31 ] introduces non-uniform motion via a programmable dolly and mitigates misalignment through repeated capture and frame selection, but is limited to controlled indoor scenes with static objects, lacking outdoor scenarios and real motion.
SDE [ 4 ] uses a robotic arm to capture more diverse motion than prior methods and records scenes with a DAVIS 346 event camera before applying an ND8 filter for low-light sequences. However, its low resolution (346×260) limits effectiveness for detail restoration.

blocks.en: These benchmarks all share a common limitation: their data capture process requires re-recording scenes under different lighting conditions, thus restricting the scene motion, due to the need for accurate frame alignment. The consequence of this is that these datasets do not exhibit heavy motion blur from moving objects; a key degradation found in low-light videos which compromises perceptual fidelity and performance in computer vision tasks. Table 1 shows that OLiVES is the only one to combine dynamic camera and object motion with VOS annotations.
blocks.zh: 这些基准都有一个共同的限制:它们的数据捕捉过程需要在不同照明条件下重新记录场景,从而限制场景运动,因为需要准确的帧对接. 其结果是,这些数据集不会从移动的物体中显示出沉重的运动模糊;在低光度视频中发现了一个关键的降解,它损害了计算机视觉任务中的概念忠诚和性能。 表1显示OLiVES是唯一一个将动态相机和物体运动与VOS说明相结合的.

blocks.en:
Video object segmentation (VOS) is a high-level computer vision downstream task which extends the object tracking task by producing segmentation masks of objects of interest rather than bounding boxes. This provides a fine-grained understanding of the shape of the objects.
Semi-supervised VOS is typical, requiring additional data to guide the method to correctly segment the object; this is most often a mask of the first frame where an object appears.
Popular VOS benchmarks such as DAVIS [ 35 , 36 ] , YouTube-VOS [ 42 , 46 ] , MOSEv1 [ 10 ] all provide annotations for the mask-initialization semi-supervised setting. Most of these benchmarks only consider objects located in the first frame except for YouTube-VOS which adds an additional difficulty to the task by having videos where new objects appear in later frames.
blocks.zh:
视频对象分解(VOS)是一项高级计算机下游视觉任务,它通过制作利益对象分解口罩来扩展对象跟踪任务,而不是捆绑相框. 这提供了对物体形状的精细理解.
半监督 VOS是典型的,需要额外的数据来指导正确划分对象的方法;这最常是出现对象的第一个框架的遮罩.
流行VOS基准,如DAVIS [35,36],YouTube-VOS [42,46],MOSEv1 [10]都为面具-初始化半监督设置提供了说明. 除了YouTube-VOS之外,这些基准大多只考虑位于第一个框架的物体,它增加了任务的困难,因为它在以后的框架里出现了新的物体。

blocks.en:
While these datasets are valuable for real-world applications, they provide normal-light videos. Only MOSEv2 [ 11 ] includes low-light scenes, but does not explicitly separate them, grouping them with other challenging conditions such as underwater scenes and adverse weather. Li et al. [23] introduce LLE-VOS, a low-light VOS benchmark with aligned normal/low-light RGB frames, event data, and annotations. While it addresses a gap in the low-light domain, it has several limitations. First, performance relies heavily on event data, which is unavailable in standard cameras, limiting generalisability to RGB-only settings. Second, the low resolution (DAVIS 346) restricts fine-grained segmentation. In addition, the frames exhibit an orange colour cast from the capture process, potentially biasing model behaviour.
The statistics of these VOS datasets are summarized in Table 2 . Only our dataset and YouTube-VOS support objects that emerge after the first frame.
blocks.zh:
虽然这些数据集对现实世界的应用很有价值,但它们提供了平凡的光线视频. 只有MOSEv2 [11] 包括了低光度场景,但并未明确将它们分开,将其与水下场景和恶劣天气等有挑战性的其他条件分组. 李等编. [23]引入了LLE-VOS,这是一个低光度的VOS基准,与对齐的普通/低光度RGB框架,事件数据和说明. 虽然它解决了低光域中的一个漏洞,但有多个局限性. 首先,性能严重依赖于事件数据,在标准相机中无法获取,将可通用性限制在只使用RGB的设置上. 其次,低分辨率(DAVIS 346)限制了细分化. 此外,相框还展现出从捕捉过程中所铸出的一种橙色,可能带有偏见的模型行为.

blocks.en: 3.1 Dataset Collection
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集收集

blocks.en:
Fig. 2 shows our capture setup, where a Genlock timecode system enables temporally synchronized low-light and ground-truth videos in a dual-exposure camera system. Two cameras are mounted on a Harrier beam-splitter rig and a GFM camera dolly and jib to enable smooth, controlled motion without affecting camera alignment. The beam-splitter rig ensures precise physical alignment and divides incoming light equally into two optical paths via a high-quality 50/50 half-silvered mirror, allowing both cameras to capture identical images.
Neutral density (ND) filters (Formatt Hitech Firecrest 1.2, 1.5, and 1.8), corresponding to transmittance ratios of 1/16, 1/32, and 1/64, are inserted into one path to simulate low-light conditions. These filters provide near-perfect light attenuation without noticeable color shift. The other path records the corresponding normal-light reference. A monitor connected to the cameras is used for real-time footage inspection.
For high-fidelity image acquisition, we use two professional RED V-RAPTOR cameras paired with Zeiss Prime lenses. Following standard cinematography practice, we fix the ISO at 800, the frame rate at 25 fps, the aperture at F8 to maintain sufficient depth of field in outdoor scenes, and the shutter speed at 1/100 s to reduce motion blur. All other parameters are kept at their default settings. This setup represents a practical upper bound achievable with current imaging technology.
blocks.zh:
图2显示了我们的捕捉设定,其中Genlock的时码系统可以在双接触相机系统中对低光和地上真实的视频进行时间同步. 两台相机被安装在一台哈里尔光束散射钻机上,并安装了一台GFM相机多利相机和jib相机,以便在不影响相机对接的情况下实现平稳的受控运动. 光束散射钻机确保精确的物理对接,通过高品质的50/50半硅镜将入射光平分为两个光学路径,使两个相机都能捕捉出相同的图像.
中性密度(ND)滤波器(Format Hitech Firecrest 1.2, 1.5,和 1.8),相当于1/16,1/32和1/64的传递比被插入到一个路径来模拟低光条件. 这些滤波器提供近乎完美的光衰减而无显著的颜色变化. 其他路径记录相应的正则光参考. 与相机连接的显示器用于实时录像检查.
对于高纯度图像的获取,我们使用两台专业RED V-RAPTOR相机与Zeiss Prime相机对接. 按照标准的电影制作惯例,我们把ISO固定在800分,帧率固定在25英尺以内,孔径固定在F8以保持室外场景的足够深度,快门速度固定在1/100 s以降低运动模糊. 所有其他参数都保留在其默认设置上. 这种设置代表了一种实际的上行捆绑,用目前的成像技术可以实现.

blocks.en:
Existing low-light video datasets [ 40 , 13 , 31 , 4 ] predominantly contain scenes with limited motion and close-up fine textures, due to constraints in their capture setups. To address this limitation, we deliberately capture scenes with richer and more diverse dynamics. In particular, to record natural wildlife behavior, we film animals, including lemur, gelada, meerkat, giraffe, and zebra in open zoo (Bristol Zoo Project by Bristol Zoological Society, UK) enclosures. We further include outdoor scenes featuring building textures and dynamic elements such as flags, pedestrians, and vehicles, with complex scenarios including occlusions and object interactions.
With the support of professional photographers, our dataset spans a wide range of dynamic outdoor scenarios, including humans, animals, and less commonly studied objects such as flags and balls. The captured high-resolution RAW data are first converted to 4096 × \times 2160 RGB images using the official REDCINE-X PRO platform with default image signal processing settings. We then crop 1920 × \times 1080 regions of interest and divide long recordings into short clips of 3 to 10 seconds.
blocks.zh:
现有的低光相机数据集 [40, 13, 31, 4] 主要包含动作有限和特写精细纹理的场景,因其捕捉设置受到限制. 为解决这一局限性,我们有意以更丰富、更多样化的动态捕捉场景。 特别是,为了记录自然野生动物的行为,我们在露天动物园拍摄动物,包括狐猴,凝胶,美尔卡特,长颈鹿和斑马(英国布里斯托动物学会的布里斯托尔动物园项目)的封口. 我们进一步包括户外场景,其特点是建筑纹理和动态元素,如旗帜、行人和车辆等,其复杂情节包括隔离和物体相互作用。
在专业摄影师的支持下,我们的数据集跨越了广泛的动态室外情景,包括人类,动物,以及不太常见的研究对象如旗帜和球等. 被捕获的高分辨率RAW数据首先被转换为4096×\times 2160 RGB图像,使用官方的REDCINE-X PRO平台进行默认的图像信号处理设置. 然后,我们收获1920 ×\时有1080个感兴趣地区,并将长录音分为短片3到10秒.

blocks.en: 3.2 Dataset Registration
blocks.zh: 3.2 数据集登记

blocks.en: Figure 3: Registration pipeline of the OLiVES dataset.
blocks.zh: 图3:OLiVES数据集的登记管道。

blocks.en: Although Genlock ensures temporal synchronization between the two cameras, small spatial misalignments may remain between paired frames due to imperfections in beam-splitter geometry and lens calibration. To address this, we estimate dense pixel-wise correspondences using finetuned RoMa [ 12 ] , followed by a warping procedure to align each normal-light frame to its corresponding low-light frame, as illustrated in Fig. 3 . The low-light frames are kept unchanged, preserving their original distortion characteristics. The resulting transformations are limited to minor geometric corrections and do not modify photometric or structural content, thereby maintaining the validity of the normal-light frames as reference data.
blocks.zh: 虽然Genlock确保了两相机之间的时间同步,但由于束-散射几何和镜头校正上的不完善,小空间错位可能仍然会留在对框之间. 为了解决这个问题,我们使用微调的RoMa [12] 来估计密集的像素-wisel-with 函式,然后是将每个正光框与相应的低光框相配合的扭曲程序,如Fig所示. 3 (英语). 低光相框保持不变,保留了原来的扭曲特性. 由此而来的变化仅限于微小的几何校正,不修改光度或结构内容,从而保持了普通光帧作为参考数据的有效性.

blocks.en:
RoMa [ 12 ] produces high-quality dense correspondences along with confidence maps under standard conditions, but directly applying the pre-trained model to our dataset leads to noticeable artifacts. This mainly arises from (i) severe domain shift between normal and low-light images, and (ii) noise and detail loss in low-light input.
To improve robustness, we finetune RoMa using synthetically degraded data that mimics real low-light conditions as shown in Fig. 4 . We leverage the synthetic low-light pipeline proposed by Lin et al. [30] to create synthetic low-light pairs with degradations from our captured low-light frames, and use these synthetic frames for finetuning RoMA. In addition to this, we use contrastive learning to enforce degradation invariant feature representations. We provide further details of the finetuning process in Appendix A .
blocks.zh:
RoMa [12] 在标准条件下制作高质量的密集通信,同时制作自信地图,但直接将事先训练过的模型应用到我们的数据集中,导致显著的文物. 这主要出自于 (一)普通图像和低光图像之间的严重域位转移, (二)低光输入中的噪音和细节损失.
为了提高稳健性,我们利用合成退化的数据来微调RoMa,这些数据模仿了法格所示的真正低光条件. 4 (韩语). 我们利用林等提出的合成低光管. [30]用我们捕获到的低光框产生有降解作用的合成低光框,并用这些合成框来微调RoMA. 除此之外,我们使用对比性学习 强制降解的无变异特征表达。 我们进一步详细介绍了附录A中的微调过程。

blocks.en:
As low-light videos from different ND filters exhibit distinct statistical characteristics, we tailor registration strategies as in Fig. 3 .
For ND1.2, where details are largely preserved, we use histogram matching (HM) to reduce the brightness gap, followed by RoMa-based dense warping for alignment. We bypass enhancement for ND1.2 to keep the detail matching as accurate as possible.
For ND1.5, which exhibits stronger noise, we first apply TempRetinex [ 26 ] for enhancement and denoising, followed by HM and dense warping.
For ND1.8, where severe noise and color distortion compromise dense matching, we instead select reliable matched feature points using the confidence maps, and estimate a homography by RANSAC for global alignment, effectively avoiding local artifacts while maintaining alignment stability.
blocks.zh:
由于来自不同ND过滤器的低光能视频显示出不同的统计特征,因此我们按照图3调整登记战略。
对ND1.2来说,在细节基本保存的地方,我们使用直方图匹配(HM)来缩小亮度差距,其次是以RoMa为基点的密集对齐. 我们绕过ND1.2的增强,使细节匹配尽可能准确.
对于显示更强烈噪声的ND1.5,我们首先应用了Tempretinex [26] 来增强和去诺,然后是HM和稠密的摇摆.
对于ND1.8, 严重的噪音和色彩扭曲会损害密集的匹配, 我们选择了可靠的匹配特征点 使用置信地图, 并估算 RANSAC 为全球对齐,

blocks.en: 3.3 VOS Benchmark Setup
blocks.zh: 3.3 VOS 基准设置

blocks.en:
In order to provide similar lengths of videos to existing VOS benchmarks, we first randomly split the videos into smaller video clips between 40 and 100 frames. Next, we filtered the clips that were unsuitable for the VOS task (e.g. clips with no objects to track).
Unlike LLE-VOS [ 23 ] , we include clips with emerging/disappearing objects in our benchmark for additional difficulty. This also allows for a more practical applicability as objects cannot be guaranteed to remain within the frame.
For the train/validation/test splits, we used the ratios 40%/30%/30%. We ensured that the test split remained the same as the test split for the LLVE task, while for the train/validation splits, we randomly selected clips from the LLVE train split for the respective VOS splits.
blocks.zh:
为了提供与现有VOS基准相类似的视频长度,我们首先随机将视频分拆为40到100帧之间的更小的视频片段. 接下来,我们过滤了不适合VOS任务的剪辑(例如没有对象跟踪的剪辑).
与LLE-VOS [23] 不同的是,我们把带有正在出现/消失的物体的片段列入我们的基准,以备额外困难. 这也允许更实际的适用性,因为不能保证物体留在框架内。
对于列车/验证/测试拆分,我们采用了40%/30%/30%的比例. 我们确保了测试分解与LLVE任务测试分解不变,而对于列车/验证分解,我们随机从LLVE列车分解中选择了对应VOS分解的片段.

blocks.en:
We provide annotations for 10 categories: person , giraffe , zebra , monkey , meerkat , lemur , boat , car , flag , ball .
For the training set, we first created pseudo ground truth masks by prompting SAM2 [ 38 ] using bounding boxes of the objects of interest onto the aligned normal-light videos. However, we found that the annotations generated with SAM2 are imperfect and thus we decided to refine a subset of the train set manually. As refining over 35K annotations is extremely time-consuming, especially for our videos where we capture difficult textures like animal fur, we randomly select 33% of the train videos for refinement; balancing the trade-off between manual-labor and effectiveness. The refinement process was case-by-case and involved using several procedures including: applying SAM2 again on later frames to reduce the mask drift in later frames, prompting SAM2 with a mask manually drawn for better guidance, and manually editing the generated masks.
We implemented the same refinement approach for the validation set to reduce the inaccuracies from SAM2.
For the test set, we hired annotators to manually annotate the objects in the videos, referring to the matched normal-light frame for better visibility. To guide the annotators, we provided the first segmentation mask of every object in the test set. During this manual annotation process, we employed an iterative feedback loop by regularly reviewing and refining the annotations, to ensure high-quality masks. See Appendix C for details on the annotation process.
blocks.zh:
我们提供10类的说明:人、长颈鹿、斑马、猴子、梅卡特、狐猴、船、汽车、旗帜、球。
对于训练集,我们首先通过将SAM2[38] 使用利益对象的边框来将相接的普通光线视频来提示,从而创建了伪地真假口罩. 然而,我们发现由SAM2生成的说明是不完善的,因此我们决定手动完善一编组列车. 我们随机选择33%的列车录像进行改进; 平衡人工实验室和有效性之间的取舍。 改进过程是逐一进行,涉及使用若干程序,包括:再次在后方框架上应用SAM2来减少后方框架的口罩漂移;用手动绘制的口罩来提示SAM2,以提供更好的指导;手动编辑生成的口罩.
我们对该套鉴定采用了同样的改进方法,以减少SAM2的不准确之处。
对于测试集,我们聘请了注释员手动对视频中的对象进行注释,指匹配的正则光框来提高能见度. 为了指导注释器,我们提供了测试集中每个物体的第一个分解口罩. 在这一人工注释过程中,我们通过定期审查和完善说明,采用了迭代反馈循环,以确保高质量的口罩。 见附录 C 说明过程的细节。

blocks.en: 3.5 Limitations
blocks.zh: 3.5 限制

blocks.en: While OLiVES addresses the challenges of other low-light video datasets, OLiVES has several limitations that we acknowledge: (1) the dataset is captured exclusively in outdoor daytime conditions with ND-filter-simulated low light rather than true low-light illumination; while this enables paired ground-truth capture, the noise and colour characteristics may differ from real low-light footage. (2) The scenes are restricted to a single geographic region, which may constrain generalisation. (3) The beam-splitter setup limits capture to tripod-based scenarios, excluding handheld and aerial footage. (4) While a subset of annotations is manually refined, the remaining training masks are generated by SAM2 without human verification and may contain errors.
blocks.zh: 虽然OLiVES解决了其他低光视频数据集的挑战,但是OLiVES有我们承认的几个局限性: (1)该数据集完全在室外白天条件下捕获,并有ND-滤光相模拟的低光,而不是真实的低光照明;虽然这可以实现对地-真实的捕捉,但噪音和色彩特征可能不同于真实的低光镜头. (2)场景仅限于单一地理区域,这可能会限制通俗化. (3)分光分光器设置限制捕获到基于三脚架的场景,不包括手持和空中镜头. (4) 虽然一组说明是手工改进的,但其余的训练口罩是由SAM2生成的,没有人验证,可能含有出错.

blocks.en: 4.1 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 4.1 详细执行情况

blocks.en:
We conducted all of our experiments on a shared cluster where each node utilizes 4 NVIDIA GH200s superchips. One NVIDIA GH200 superchip is comprised of a 72-core NVIDIA Grace CPU (with 120GB CPU memory) and a NVIDIA H100 GPU (with 96GB GPU memory).
Each of the experiments we conducted varied greatly in runtime (due to different training configurations, architectures, etc.), but we estimate the total GPU hours is ∼ \sim 500 hours.
blocks.zh:
我们在一个共享的集群上进行了所有实验 每个节点都使用4个NVIDIA GH200s超级芯片。 一台NVIDIA GH200超芯片由一款72分的NVIDIA Grace CPU(有120GB CPU内存)和一款NVIDIA H100 GPU(有96GB GPU内存)所组成.
我们进行的每一项实验在运行时间上都大相径庭(因为不同的训练配置,建筑等),但我们估计GPU的总时数是\\相500小时.

blocks.en: We establish a comprehensive benchmark on OLiVES using a wide range of state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods for both LLIE and LLVE. For a fair comparison, supervised methods [ 43 , 41 , 2 , 40 , 49 , 44 , 24 , 32 , 20 , 45 ] , and unsupervised methods [ 51 , 52 , 25 , 26 ] are trained on OLiVES with the settings from the original works. Notably, GT is incorporated as input priors in [ 21 ] while excluded from the loss function during training; thus, we categorize it as an unpaired method.
blocks.zh: 我们为LLIE和LLVE制定了一套综合的OLiVES基准,采用一系列最先进的方法。 为了进行公平的比较,对受监督的方法[43,41,2,40,49,44,24,32,20,45],以及无监督的方法[51,52,25,26]进行OLiVES培训,其设置来自原作. 值得注意的是,GT在[21]中被编入输入前科,但在培训期间则被排除在损失功能之外;因此,我们将其归类为一种不成熟的方法。

blocks.en: We employed several state-of-the-art semi-supervised VOS methods for our low-light VOS task, including STCN [ 8 ] , AOT [ 47 ] , De-AOT [ 48 ] , XMem [ 7 ] , and Cutie [ 6 ] . For fair comparison, we considered only architectures using a ResNet-50 [ 18 ] feature extractor. All methods were initialized using the authors’ publicly released weights pretrained on DAVIS 2017 [ 36 ] and YouTube-VOS [ 42 ] , and then finetuned on our training set for 30,000 iterations using a batch size of 8 and a learning rate of 1 × \times 10 -4 . The only exception was OASIS [ 37 ] , for which only ResNet-18 pre-trained weights were publicly available. To ensure consistency, we first re-trained OASIS following its original training protocol on DAVIS 2017 and YouTube-VOS, before finetuning it on our dataset using the same settings as the other methods.
blocks.zh: 我们使用几种最先进的半监督VOS方法来完成我们的低亮VOS任务,包括STCN [8],AOT [47],De-AOT [48],XMem [7],和Cutie [6]. 为了进行公平的比较,我们只考虑使用ResNet-50[18]特性提取器的架构. 所有方法都采用作者在DAVIS 2017 [36] 和 YouTube-VOS [42] 上预选的公开发布的权重来初始化,然后用批量尺寸为8,学习率为1×x正时为10-4的分量来微调我们为30,000次重复的集训. 唯一的例外是OASIS[37],只有ResNet-18预训重量公开提供。 为确保一致性,我们首先根据关于DAVIS 2017和YouTube-VOS的最初培训协议,对OASIS进行再培训,然后使用与其他方法相同的设置对数据集进行微调。

blocks.en: 4.2 Low-Light Video Enhancement
blocks.zh: 4.2 低光视频增强

blocks.en: For the evaluation metrics, we adopt PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS [ 50 ] to measure the image restoration quality. To further assess video quality and temporal consistency, we employ tLPIPS [ 9 ] , Warping Error (WE) [ 22 ] , and VMAF [ 28 ] . The evaluate results on our test set is reported in Table 4 .
blocks.zh: 对于评价指标,我们采用PSNR,SSIM,LPIPS[50]来测量图像恢复质量. 为了进一步评估视频质量和时间一致性,我们采用了tLPIPS [9],Warping Error (WE) [22],以及VMAF [28]. 测试结果见表4。

blocks.en:
We observe a clear performance gap between supervised and unsupervised approaches, and between image-based and video-based methods:
(i) Image-based methods generally achieve higher PSNR and VMAF scores than video-based methods (e.g., Retinexformer [ 2 ] ), but often exhibit weaker temporal consistency, as reflected by higher tLPIPS and WE values. In contrast, video-based methods produce more temporally stable results; for example, BVI-CDM [ 32 ] and BVI-Mamba [ 20 ] achieve lower tLPIPS and competitive WE scores, albeit at the cost of reduced contrast. (ii) Unsupervised and unpaired methods exhibit a substantial performance drop compared to supervised approaches across all metrics. For example, [ 52 ] and [ 51 ] achieve lower PSNR and higher LPIPS, highlighting the difficulty of learning robust enhancement without paired supervision on our dataset.
blocks.zh:
我们发现,在监督和非监督方法之间,以及在基于图像的方法和基于视频的方法之间,存在着明显的性能差距:
(一)以图像为基础的方法一般比以视频为基础的方法(如:Retinexformer [2])实现更高的PSNR和VMAF分数,但往往表现出更弱的时间一致性,这体现在较高的tLPIPS和WE值上. 相形之下,基于视频的方法产生时间上比较稳定的结果;例如,BVI-CDM[32]和BVI-Mamba[20]实现了较低的tLPIPS和有竞争力的WE分数,尽管代价是对比度降低. (二) 与所有衡量尺度的监管方法相比,无监管和无监管方法的绩效大幅下降。 例如,[52]和[51]实现较低的PSNR和更高的LPIPS,凸显了在不配对地监督我们数据集的情况下学习强增强的难度.

blocks.en: Overall, methods trained on OLiVES struggle under severe degradations. While some approaches perform well on individual metrics, no single method consistently achieves strong results across both quality and temporal measures. This indicates the value of OLiVES as a challenging benchmark and impresses the need for joint optimization of restoration quality and temporal consistency. Further qualitative analysis is provided in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 总的来说,在严重退化的情况下,对OLiVES斗争的方法进行了培训。 虽然有些方法在个别衡量标准上表现良好,但没有任何单一方法在质量和时间衡量方面都始终取得显著成果。 这表明OLiVES作为一个具有挑战性的基准的价值,并提醒人们需要共同优化恢复质量和时间一致性。 附录B提供了进一步的质量分析。

blocks.en: 4.3 Video Object Segmentation
blocks.zh: 4.3 视频对象分割

blocks.en:
We provide a quantitative evaluation of several state-of-the-art VOS methods trained on our dataset, and assess their performance on our validation and test sets, as well as the LLE-VOS [ 23 ] validation set, to demonstrate the generalization of our training data across low-light benchmarks.
We use standard VOS evaluation metrics [ 35 , 36 ] : Jaccard Index ( 𝒥 \mathcal{J} ), F-measure ( ℱ \mathcal{F} ) and 𝒥 & ℱ \mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F} . Results are reported in Table 5 .
We report that [ 6 ] and [ 37 ] show the strongest performance on OLiVES and LLE-VOS, while [ 48 ] achieves the second-strongest performance on LLE-VOS. STCN [ 8 ] performs poorly on LLE-VOS, suggesting that its earlier architecture struggles to generalize across domains.

blocks.en: We further evaluate the VOS performance of four LLVE methods [ 2 , 20 , 45 ] trained on OLiVES within a two-stage pipeline, where enhancement is applied as a pre-processing step before inference with a pre-trained VOS model. For this experiment, we use Cutie with off-the-shelf weights for segmentation after enhancement. Evaluation on the LLE-VOS validation set assesses the effectiveness of our training data for LLVE; results are reported in Table 6 .
blocks.zh: 我们进一步评价在两相管线内接受OLiVES培训的四种LLVE方法[2,20,45]的VOS性能,在采用预先训练的VOS模型进行推论前,将增强作为预处理步骤. 对于这个实验,我们使用有现成重量的Cutie在增强后进行分化. 对LLE-VOS验证集的评价评估了我们为LLVE提供的培训数据的有效性;结果见表6。

blocks.en: We find that all VOS methods perform well even without fine-tuning on our dataset (see Appendix D ), indicating strong object detectability. However, segmentation quality remains limited, with inaccurate boundaries and missing fine details (e.g., animal fur). This suggests that, while current methods are suitable for detection-oriented applications such as surveillance, they fall short for tasks requiring fine-grained detail, such as film post-production, augmented reality, and robotics manipulation, where accurate boundaries and fine structures are critical. We further analyze this behavior in Appendix E .
blocks.zh: 我们发现,所有VOS方法的性能都很好,即使没有对我们的数据集进行微调(见附录D),这表明了强烈的物体可探测性。 然而,分化的质量仍然有限,边界不准确并缺少细细的细节(如动物毛). 这表明,虽然目前的方法适合监视等面向探测的应用,但对于需要精细细细节的任务,如电影后出品,增强现实,机器人操纵,精确的界限和精细的结构至关重要. 我们在附录E中进一步分析了这种行为。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We present OLiVES, a new low-light video dataset supporting both low-light video enhancement (LLVE) and video object segmentation (VOS). OLiVES introduces diverse challenges, including complex motion, rich natural textures (e.g., textures of animal furs), and a wide range of illumination conditions that are widely absent by existing low-light datasets. In particular, it provides new data for low-light VOS, featuring occlusions, emerging objects, and degraded appearances due to motion blur, without reliance on auxiliary modalities such as event data.
By establishing a unified benchmark for both LLVE and VOS, OLiVES facilitates research that jointly advances perceptual quality and semantic understanding. We hope this dataset will encourage further work in low-light video analysis and inspire more robust methods for challenging real-world conditions.
blocks.zh:
我们提出OLiVES,是一种新的低光能视频数据集,支持低光能视频增强(LLVE)和视频物体分解(VOS)两种功能. OLiVES引入了多种挑战,包括复杂的运动,丰富的自然纹理(如动物毛发的纹理),以及被现有低光能数据集所广泛缺少的多种发光条件. 特别是,它为低光能VOS提供了新的数据,其特征是被遮住,出现物体,以及运动模糊而导致外观退化,而不依赖于事件数据等辅助模式.
通过为LLVE和VOS制定统一的基准,OLiVES促进了联合推进知觉质量和语义理解的研究. 我们希望,这一数据集将鼓励在低光影视分析方面进一步开展工作,并激励采用更强有力的方法来挑战现实世界的条件。

blocks.en: We recruited 9 annotators to manually produce ground-truth labels for the OLiVES test set by using our custom annotation software. We provided annotators with both the normal and low-light frames; the normal-light frames were for initial annotations and the low-light frames were to verify that they are correct. To ensure consistency and reduce ambiguity, annotators were provided with the first-frame object masks indicating when each instance appears in the sequence. We also provided them with custom annotation software, alongside detailed training materials (video tutorial and written instructions). The software included sliders to adjust brightness, contrast and saturation to help with verifying masks in low-light. We provide a screenshot of the tool in Fig. 7 .
blocks.zh: 我们聘用了9位注释员,通过使用我们的自定义注释软件,手动为OLiVES测试集制作地表真实标签. 我们向注释员提供了普通和低光相框;普通光相框是用于初始说明的,而低光相框则是用来验证其正确性. 为确保一致性并减少模糊性,向注释员提供了第一帧物体口罩,说明每个实例何时出现在序列中。 我们还向他们提供了定制的注释软件以及详细的培训材料(视频辅导和书面指导)。 软件包括滑动器来调整亮度,对比度和饱和度来帮助验证低灯口罩. 我们在图7中提供了工具的截图。

blocks.en:
Annotations were collected on a weekly basis, allowing us to perform regular quality assessments and provide targeted feedback. Annotators who consistently failed to meet quality standards were replaced, and their assigned videos were re-annotated by other workers. Following this initial stage, we introduced a second stage in which annotators reviewed and refined sequences they had not originally labeled, helping to improve consistency across the dataset.
Finally, we conducted an additional round of review to perform minor corrections and ensure a uniformly high standard of annotation quality. All annotators were compensated at rates above the local minimum wage.
blocks.zh:
每周收集说明,使我们能够定期进行质量评估并提供有针对性的反馈。 一直未能达到质量标准的注解员被替换,其分配的视频被其他工人重新注解. 在这一初始阶段之后,我们引入了第二阶段,其中注释员审查和完善了他们原先没有标注的序列,帮助改进了各数据集的一致性。
最后,我们又进行了一轮审查,以进行小的更正,并确保统一高标准的说明质量。 所有公证员都得到高于当地最低工资的补偿。

blocks.en:
Furthermore, to show the cross-domain capabilities of our training data for low-light VOS tasks, we compare Cutie [ 6 ] with its off-the-shelf weights (DAVIS 2017 [ 36 ] and YouTube-VOS [ 42 ] ), finetuned on LLE-VOS [ 23 ] and finetuned on OLiVES.
We run inference on an example low-light video from the MOSEv2 [ 11 ] dataset and visualize our results in Fig. 8 . Here, we find using the pre-trained weights, Cutie incorrectly produces segmentation masks for the people in the distance despite being occluded by a person in the foreground, while the finetuned model on LLE-VOS performed better with the occlusion but still produced masks in frame 5 despite the person not reappearing in the scene. Meanwhile, the model finetuned on OLiVES was able to correctly produce no segmentation masks when occluded.
blocks.zh:
此外,为了展示我们用于低亮VOS任务的训练数据的跨域能力,我们比较了Cutie [6] 及其现成重量(DAVIS 2017 [36]和YouTube-VOS [42]),微调了LLE-VOS [23] 并微调了OLiVES.
我们从MOSEv2[11]数据集的一例低光视频中推断出我们的结果在Fig. 8 (英语). 在这里,我们发现利用预先训练的重量,Cutie不正确地为远处的人生产分块口罩,尽管前面的人占有了分块口罩,而LLE-VOS上的微调型号在被隔离的情况下表现较好,但仍在框5中生产出口罩,尽管这个人没有重新出现在现场. 同时,在OLiVES上被微调的模型能够正确生产出没有分解口罩被吞噬.

blocks.en: To determine the cause of the high VOS performance, we group the objects by size and calculate the common VOS metrics: 𝒥 & ℱ \mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F} , 𝒥 \mathcal{J} and ℱ \mathcal{F} . We collect these results using the pre-trained Cutie [ 6 ] (to avoid bias to the dataset) and present them in Table 9 . We find that performances vary for small and medium objects but large objects have significantly higher scores. We can determine that the variance in performance for small and medium objects is due to the low count of both sizes.
blocks.zh: 为了确定高VOS性能的原因,我们将对象按大小分组并计算出常见的VOS度量衡:J & F\mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F},J\mathcal{J}和F\mathcal{F}. 我们利用预训的Cutie[6](避免对数据集的偏见)来收集这些结果,并将结果列入表9。 我们发现,中小物体的性能各不相同,但大物体的分数要高得多。 我们可以确定中小物体性能的差异是由于两者大小的计数都很低.

blocks.en: However, closer inspection reveals that even when trained on our dataset, Cutie fails to capture fine-grained textures (see Fig. 9 ). In these examples, we can see that Cutie struggled to segment the details of the fur of the animals, as well as handling occlusions. While such performance may be sufficient for surveillance applications, it falls short of the precision required for post-production tasks, where high-quality, finely detailed masks are essential.
blocks.zh: 然而,更仔细的检查表明,即使受过我们数据集的培训,Cutie也无法捕捉到精细的纹理(见图9)。 在这些例子中,我们可以看到可爱为了分解动物皮毛的细节,以及处理隔离而挣扎. 虽然这种性能可能足以用于监视应用,但是它没有达到生产后任务所需的精确度,因为高质量、细微详细的口罩是必不可少的。

blocks.en: We conclude that due to the unbalanced size distribution of our dataset (refer to Fig. 5 (d)) and the bias of models on large objects, this results in numerically high VOS performances.
blocks.zh: 我们的结论是,由于我们数据集的大小分布不平衡(参见图5(d)),模型偏向于大对象,这导致了VOS性能数值高.
